name: Churchill Island
bio_draft: 57-hectare island reached by causeway, with a heritage farm and a farmers' market.

name: Cape Woolamai
bio_draft: cape with walking loops among shearwater burrows and a surf beach at the island's south-east.

name: Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit
bio_draft: purpose-built 1950s circuit hosting the MotoGP Australian Grand Prix, open to visitors on non-event days through track tours.

name: National Vietnam Veterans Museum
bio_draft: volunteer-run museum of Vietnam War memorabilia at Cape Woolamai, with over 5,000 items.

name: Rhyll Inlet and Conservation Hill
bio_draft: inlet and wetlands at Rhyll, a feeding and breeding area for birds, with a boardwalk pathway.

name: Phillip Island Chocolate Factory
bio_draft: commercial factory with a paid interactive chocolate attraction (Panny's Amazing World of Chocolate) at Newhaven.
